user.title: HomeKit TV Remote
user.description: Select the TV you paired through the HomeKit Device integration.

data_description.media_player_entity_id: Only TVs paired through HomeKit Device are listed.
data_description.tv_name: Sets both entity IDs. Sony TV gives remote.sony_tv and media_player.sony_tv.

abort.no_homekit_tv: No paired TV found. Pair it through HomeKit Device first.
abort.already_configured: This TV is already set up.

init.title: HomeKit TV Remote
init.description: Changes apply immediately. Press Reload HomeKit Bridge on the device page when you are done.

menu_option_descriptions.tv_inputs: Choose which of the TV's inputs to expose.
menu_option_descriptions.shortcut: Add an app or another integration's command.

tv_inputs.title: TV inputs
tv_inputs.description: Ticked inputs appear in Apple Home, in the source list, and in the ⓘ cycle.

data_description.sources: Read from the TV. Nothing to type.
data_description.test_input: Switches the TV to it now, without saving. Leave empty to save your selection.

shortcut.title: Add a shortcut
shortcut.description: An input that drives another integration: an Apple TV app, a vendor remote command.

data_description.name: Shown in Apple Home and in the source list.
data_description.target: The media player or remote that carries it out.
data_description.action: App name for a media player, command name for a remote. select_source or play_media is chosen automatically.
data_description.tv_source: Optional. Changes the TV's input before running the action.
data_description.test: Sends it now without saving. Untick to save.

menu_option_descriptions.rename: Change the label. Behaviour and position stay.
menu_option_descriptions.reorder: Move one input through the cycle.

rename.title: Rename
rename.description: Changes the label only. The form reopens so you can rename several.

reorder.title: Reorder
reorder.description: The order the ⓘ button and Next input step through. The list renumbers after each move.

error.name_taken: That name is already in use.
error.test_sent: Sent. Untick Test and submit to save.
error.test_failed: Failed. See the log for the reason.
error.name_clash: One of those inputs has the same name as a saved shortcut. Rename the shortcut first.

abort.no_sources: The TV reports no inputs. Switch it on and try again.
